stem:
The diagram represents the floor of a storage building. The floor is composed of two rectangles.

What is the area of the floor in square yards?
instruction: Record your answer and fill in the bubbles on your answer document. Be sure to use the correct place value.
visual_elements: Diagram showing floor area composed of two rectangles with a key showing one shaded square equals 1 square yard
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding of area calculation by decomposing a composite figure into two rectangles and summing their areas, a modest reasoning step beyond direct recall.
